key_points: Only material item: SLB won a long-term offshore drilling services contract with Var Energi in Norway, extending revenue visibility toward 2034
Single regional contract is incremental, not thesis-changing, for a company of SLB's scale — supports international/offshore growth narrative
Remaining headlines are noise: generic trading-zone commentary, a relative-performance note, and unrelated clickbait about Liberty Energy/Anthropic
No change to earnings, guidance, capital allocation, or management — core thesis intact
Offshore international activity remains the key swing factor to watch; deal adds modest backlog confidence
